reason: The hypothesis directly restates the deformation mechanism chain (stacking faults → twins/transformation → work hardening) established in P2, P3, P4, and P18 for the CrMnFeCoNi Cantor alloy, merely applying it to the Co-free FeNiCrMn variant without new mechanistic insight or integration of conflicting evidence. The proposed test is a standard in situ characterization approach already demonstrated in P1 and P14.
